title: b7z9.12.2: Wire C desync FSM into beacon RX and TDMA tick paths
description: Call lichen_desync_on_beacon(valid) from the beacon receive handler. Call lichen_desync_on_missed_superframe() from the TDMA superframe tick when no beacon was heard. Call lichen_desync_on_sfn_wrap(time_valid) at SFN wrap detection. The standalone functions exist in tdma.c:82-142 but are never called from production code paths. Wire lichen_epoch_floor_accepts (time_sync.c:571) as the time_valid input.
